equation_boundary.methods_A_B: reference-derived corrected four-term double difference from C4 and references [7]/[28], not literal 2016 reproduction

math.rank: truncated SVD rank-3 projection of complete corrected (M-1)x(N-1) matrix
math.coordinate_recovery: general Crocco quadratic Euclidean constraints on both determinant branches; not the co-location special case
math.gauges: coordinate translation/orthogonal ambiguity represented by mic-anchor canonicalization; timing origin e_1=0; no synchronized-clock assumption
math.identifiability: [7] gives necessary M>=5,N>=13 counts under its model, not sufficiency for degenerate geometry
